title: Star DLX MIPS Raptor TC-1

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Born for the apex and high-speed straightaways, the Bell Star DLX MIPS Raptor TC-1 is designed to deliver razor-sharp aerodynamics in a chin-on-tank tuck. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1415g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~92 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Street optimized version of the Star with MIPS protection.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; features a multi-position fit system for customization.

technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Star DLX MIPS Raptor TC-1: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Full Face lineup, the Star DLX MIPS Raptor TC-1 brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Bell Star DLX MIPS Raptor TC-1 represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~92 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Star DLX MIPS Raptor TC-1 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
